args.body:
Summary of websites posted in 'general':
1) www.informations.com: The latest job report shows mixed news, with unemployment edging down to 7.2%.
2) www.restaurant-zurich.com: Zurich Restaurant is a cozy, alpine-inspired eatery in the city center serving authentic Swiss cuisine (cheese fondue, rösti, chocolate fondue). It has warm wooden interiors, Swiss memorabilia, panoramic city views and staff in traditional Swiss attire.

Hi Dora! I visited your website. It's clean and straightforward, and the contact email is easy to find. It could use more content, such as an about section, projects or a portfolio, and some visuals, to make it more engaging.

Hi Eve! I enjoyed your blog. Your intro is friendly and it's nice to know hiking is your favorite hobby. I'd suggest adding more content, such as trip reports, photos, favorite trails and tips, and maybe a way for readers to subscribe or comment.
